message:
You know those moments when you feel a little too proud of your own foresight? Last month, as we were sorting through our go-bags—something we’ve made a habit of doing every few months—I couldn’t help but feel a bit smug. I reminded the kids of that time we had a sudden power outage and how grateful we were for the flashlights and snacks we had packed away. 

It’s a small reminder that preparing together isn't just about the stuff; it’s about the peace of mind we create as a family. Those little moments of readiness help us appreciate the calm when life throws us a curveball. Have you had a moment like that lately? 😊
